reason: The plugin is primarily an automation utility for DSH web conversations: it lets users define timed prompts and optional daily repeats, then automatically executes them via the existing /goal mechanism at the scheduled moment. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows both slash-command and browser UI workflows for task CRUD, with execution tied to full-access goal execution and persistent job storage.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于在 DSH 会话中创建一次性或每日重复定时任务的插件，支持通过斜杠命令和网页面板配置任务，并在到点时按预设提示词自动触发 /goal。
summaries.en: This plugin enables one-time or daily repeating timed tasks in DSH conversations, with slash commands and a web panel for setup, then runs the configured prompt automatically through /goal at the scheduled time.

capabilities: Time-based scheduling of prompts with optional daily recurrence
Automatic triggering of /goal execution at configured times
Per-task create/edit/delete/list management via web UI
Persistent job storage for recovery across web restarts
Automatic retry/fallback behavior on execution failure

reasons.code: Repository README documents one-time and daily scheduled tasks with absolute datetime input and future-time validation.
README states that at trigger time the session is set to danger-full-access and an armed goal is created to run the configured prompt.
README describes GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE REST endpoints for jobs and a settings/conversation UI modal for managing tasks.
Package metadata shows this is a DSH web plugin with client UI/runtime injection points, indicating host integration and command surface.
